<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>乘風破浪吧！台達熱血線上划槳暨神預測活動～</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --delta-blue: #007bb6;
            --delta-cyan: #00d4ff;
            --deep-navy: #003366;
        }
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        body {
            text-align: center;
            font-family: '微軟正黑體', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #eef7ff 0%, #dcf0ff 100%);
            margin: 0; padding: 20px;
            color: var(--deep-navy);
            position: relative;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }
        .container { max-width: 650px; margin: auto; }
        .card {
            background: #ffffff; padding: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-radius: 25px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 123, 182, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-align: left;
        }
        .comic-img { width: 100%; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); margin-bottom: 15px; }

        .title-logo { display: block; margin: 0 auto 20px auto; max-width: 420px; width: 90%; height: auto; }

        h3 { color: var(--delta-blue); margin-top: 0; }

        #paddle-btn, .submit-btn {
            display: block; margin: 20px auto; font-size: 1.3em; padding: 15px 40px; cursor: pointer;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--delta-blue), var(--delta-cyan));
            color: white; border: none; border-radius: 50px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 123, 182, 0.3);
            font-weight: bold; transition: 0.2s; width: 100%; max-width: 320px;
        }
        #paddle-btn:hover, .submit-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
        #paddle-btn:disabled { background: #b6c8d6; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }

        #count-display { font-size: 4em; font-weight: bold; color: var(--delta-blue); margin: 10px 0; text-align: center; }
        #attempts-display { text-align: center; color: #6b8ba4; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 0.95em; }
        #best-display { text-align: center; color: var(--deep-navy); margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: bold; }

        .status-banner {
            text-align: center; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; margin: 10px 0;
            font-weight: bold; min-height: 22px; transition: 0.2s;
        }
        .status-banner.info { background: #eaf6ff; color: var(--delta-blue); }
        .status-banner.warn { background: #fff3e0; color: #b9660a; }
        .status-banner.success { background: #e6f9ee; color: #1a8a4c; }
        .status-banner.empty { background: transparent; }

        input, select {
            padding: 12px 20px; font-size: 16px !important; width: 90%;
            border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid #bce1ff; margin: 0 auto 15px auto; display: block;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }
        .highlight { color: #d63384; font-weight: bold; }
        button { touch-action: manipulation; font-size: 16px; }

        /* 划槳拖曳區 */
        .paddle-stage { margin: 10px 0 18px 0; }
        .paddle-track {
            position: relative;
            height: 150px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 380px;
            background-image: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
            background-size: cover;
            background-position: center;
            border-radius: 20px;
            border: 3px solid #9fd7f5;
            overflow: hidden;
            touch-action: none;
            cursor: grab;
            user-select: none;
        }
        .paddle-track.disabled { filter: grayscale(0.6) opacity(0.6); cursor: not-allowed; }
        .paddle-track.dragging { cursor: grabbing; }
        .paddle-icon {
            position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%;
            width: 230px; height: auto;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            pointer-events: none;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25));
            transition: transform 0.05s linear;
        }
        .drag-hint { text-align: center; color: #6b8ba4; font-size: 0.9em; margin: 8px 0 0 0; }

        #leaderboard-card {
            background: #ffffff; padding: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-radius: 25px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 123, 182, 0.15);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8); text-align: left;
        }
        #leaderboard-box { cursor: pointer; border-radius: 14px; padding: 4px; transition: background 0.15s; }
        #leaderboard-box:active { background: #eaf6ff; }
        .leaderboard-hint { font-size: 0.85em; color: #6b8ba4; margin-top: 10px; text-align: center; }

        #music-toggle {
            position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%;
            border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--delta-blue), var(--delta-cyan));
            color: white; font-size: 1.4em; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 123, 182, 0.35);
            cursor: pointer; z-index: 999; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            #count-display { font-size: 3em; }
            #music-toggle { width: 46px; height: 46px; font-size: 1.2em; top: 10px; right: 10px; }
        }

        .music-panel {
            position: fixed; top: 76px; right: 16px; z-index: 998;
            background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            display: none;
        }
        .music-panel.open { display: block; }
        .music-panel-title {
            font-size: 0.85em; color: var(--deep-navy); font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 6px; text-align: center;
        }
        .music-panel iframe { display: block; border-radius: 10px; }
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .music-panel { top: 62px; right: 10px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<button id="music-toggle" onclick="toggleMusicPanel()" aria-label="播放背景音樂">🔇</button>
<div id="music-panel" class="music-panel">
    <div class="music-panel-title">🎵 點下方 ▶ 播放背景音樂</div>
    <iframe id="yt-visible-player" width="220" height="124"
        src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/s4wZG6wH3Gk?playsinline=1&rel=0&loop=1&playlist=s4wZG6wH3Gk"
        title="背景音樂" frameborder="0"
        allow="autoplay; encrypted-media" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>

<div class="container">
    <img class="title-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="2026 乘風破浪吧！熱血線上划槳 x 神預測活動">

    <div class="card">
        <img src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/d/1fNrHk2WqycPKo6TmUutbGemFCEFmsrfF" class="comic-img" alt="龍舟傳說漫畫">
    </div>

    <div class="card">
        <h3>🏆 熱血線上划槳挑戰</h3>
        <p><b>活動辦法：</b></p>
        <ul style="padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
            <li><b>挑戰期限：</b>即日起至 9/18(五) 17:30 前完成挑戰。</li>
            <li><b>參賽規則：</b>按下開始後，在 <span class="highlight">10 秒內</span>於下方龍舟圖上<strong>反覆左右拖曳划槳</strong>！每人最多挑戰 3 次，系統自動記錄最高成績。</li>
            <li><b>榮耀獎勵：</b>活動結束後，總榜前30名獲精美紀念禮品。</li>
        </ul>
        <input type="text" id="empId" placeholder="請輸入工號">

        <div id="paddle-status" class="status-banner empty"></div>

        <div id="count-display">0</div>
        <div id="attempts-display">剩餘挑戰次數：3</div>
        <div id="best-display"></div>

        <div class="paddle-stage">
            <div class="paddle-track disabled" id="paddle-drag-zone">
                <img class="paddle-icon" id="paddle-icon" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="龍舟划槳">
            </div>
            <p class="drag-hint">按下「開始挑戰」後，<strong>按住上方龍舟圖片不放</strong>，快速左右拖曳划槳！</p>
        </div>

        <button id="paddle-btn" onclick="startRound()">開始挑戰！</button>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
        <h3>🔮 神預測活動</h3>
        <p><b>活動辦法：</b></p>
        <ul style="padding-left: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px;">
            <li><b>預測期限：</b>即日起至 9/18(五) 17:30 止。</li>
            <li><b>參加規則：</b>選出心目中的冠軍隊伍，若該隊伍最終獲得前八名，即可獲得抽獎資格！總計抽出30名。</li>
            <li><b>獎勵說明：</b>成功預測者即可參加抽獎，有機會獲得精美小禮品。</li>
        </ul>
        <select id="teamSelection">
            <option value="">請選擇您看好的冠軍隊伍</option>
            <option value="BBC">BBC</option>
            <option value="划起來通通給我划起來">划起來通通給我划起來</option>
            <option value="羽知識，衝股價">羽知識，衝股價</option>
            <option value="SSI是否在台達拯救過製造">SSI是否在台達拯救過製造</option>
            <option value="好划一直划">好划一直划</option>
            <option value="女友不會李多慧">女友不會李多慧</option>
            <option value="一槳一心、一划到底，管你划不划，我們一起槳上划！">一槳一心、一划到底，管你划不划，我們一起槳上划！</option>
            <option value="晶舟勇士隊">晶舟勇士隊</option>
            <option value="晶皮力進隊">晶皮力進隊</option>
            <option value="子子">子子</option>
            <option value="台達鐵達尼">台達鐵達尼</option>
            <option value="台達DD龍">台達DD龍</option>
            <option value="佳人們講龍舟了">佳人們講龍舟了</option>
            <option value="划水第一名">划水第一名</option>
            <option value="追我要排隊4.0">追我要排隊4.0</option>
            <option value="龍咚龍咚搶第一">龍咚龍咚搶第一</option>
            <option value="水冷划冷水">水冷划冷水</option>
            <option value="合力要他命EX">合力要他命EX</option>
            <option value="乘風破爛用腳划龍舟">乘風破爛用腳划龍舟</option>
            <option value="滑達硬漢不會停">滑達硬漢不會停</option>
            <option value="斯巴達勇士2.0">斯巴達勇士2.0</option>
            <option value="雷蛇的大蟒蛇">雷蛇的大蟒蛇</option>
            <option value="EVS電馭破浪者">EVS電馭破浪者</option>
            <option value="綠咖哩划椰奶">綠咖哩划椰奶</option>
            <option value="酸辣龍蝦湯">酸辣龍蝦湯</option>
            <option value="槳拌青木瓜">槳拌青木瓜</option>
            <option value="涼拌肌肉隊">涼拌肌肉隊</option>
            <option value="只會出一張嘴">只會出一張嘴</option>
            <option value="加入台達，人生發達3.0">加入台達，人生發達3.0</option>
            <option value="資訊DataCenter整合艦隊">資訊DataCenter整合艦隊</option>
            <option value="中壢健身路跑社">中壢健身路跑社</option>
            <option value="ESP龍抬頭">ESP龍抬頭</option>
            <option value="量子機器人">量子機器人</option>
            <option value="TW3 滑蛋瘦肉舟隊">TW3 滑蛋瘦肉舟隊</option>
            <option value="全糖不減速">全糖不減速</option>
            <option value="超過我就是你不隊">超過我就是你不隊</option>
            <option value="Taina very sweet">Taina very sweet</option>
            <option value="What">What</option>
        </select>
        <div id="predict-status" class="status-banner empty"></div>
        <button class="submit-btn" onclick="submitPrediction()">送出預測</button>
    </div>

    <div id="leaderboard-card">
        <h3>📊 即時排行榜</h3>
        <div id="leaderboard-box" onclick="loadLeaderboard()">
            <div id="leaderboard">讀取中...</div>
        </div>
        <p class="leaderboard-hint">🔄 點擊上方排行榜可手動重新整理</p>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   共用：頁面內狀態提示（取代 alert，避免在部分內嵌瀏覽器中被封鎖）
   ========================================================= */
function showStatus(elId, message, type) {
    const el = document.getElementById(elId);
    el.className = "status-banner " + (type || "info");
    el.innerText = message;
}

/* =========================================================
   1. 即時排行榜
   ========================================================= */
const CSV_URL = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vT9Ftm2HvMEqZwB8dOV4JeAoU-44R2tG2JvTaFXeTesIGMMimuAgvE3rjXNlLZbjBzvzsAJYBX-0hZp/pub?gid=328708702&single=true&output=csv";

async function loadLeaderboard() {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(CSV_URL, { cache: "no-store" });
        const data = await response.text();
        const rows = data.split('\n');

        let html = '<table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">';
        rows.forEach((row) => {
            const cols = row.split(',');
            if (cols[0] && cols[0] !== "未預測") {
                html += `<tr><td style="padding:8px; border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">${cols[0]}</td>
                             <td style="text-align:right; font-weight:bold;">${cols[1] || ''}</td></tr>`;
            }
        });
        html += '</table>';
        document.getElementById('leaderboard').innerHTML = html;
    } catch (e) {
        document.getElementById('leaderboard').innerHTML = "暫無法讀取資料";
    }
}
loadLeaderboard();
setInterval(loadLeaderboard, 5 * 60 * 1000);

/* =========================================================
   2. 划槳挑戰（拖曳互動版，最多 3 次，記錄最佳成績）
   ========================================================= */
const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3;
const ROUND_SECONDS = 10;
const DRAG_THRESHOLD = 34;

let currentCount = 0;
let bestScore = 0;
let attemptsUsed = 0;
let playing = false;
let countdownTimer = null;
let roundEndTime = 0;
let lastLoadedId = null;

function storageKeyFor(id) { return "paddle_progress_" + id; }

function loadProgress(id) {
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKeyFor(id));
        const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
        attemptsUsed = (parsed && parsed.attemptsUsed) || 0;
        bestScore = (parsed && parsed.bestScore) || 0;
    } catch (e) {
        attemptsUsed = 0; bestScore = 0;
    }
    refreshPaddleUI();
}

function saveProgress(id) {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(storageKeyFor(id), JSON.stringify({ attemptsUsed, bestScore }));
    } catch (e) {}
}

function refreshPaddleUI() {
    const remaining = Math.max(0, MAX_ATTEMPTS - attemptsUsed);
    document.getElementById('attempts-display').innerText = "剩餘挑戰次數：" + remaining;
    document.getElementById('best-display').innerText = bestScore > 0 ? ("目前最佳成績：" + bestScore + " 下") : "";
    const btn = document.getElementById('paddle-btn');
    btn.disabled = remaining <= 0;
    btn.innerText = remaining <= 0 ? "挑戰次數已用完" : "開始挑戰！";
}

function setDragZoneEnabled(enabled) {
    const zone = document.getElementById('paddle-drag-zone');
    if (enabled) zone.classList.remove('disabled');
    else zone.classList.add('disabled');
}

function startRound() {
    const id = document.getElementById('empId').value.trim();
    if (!id) {
        showStatus('paddle-status', "請先輸入工號喔！", "warn");
        return;
    }
    if (id !== lastLoadedId) {
        loadProgress(id);
        lastLoadedId = id;
    }
    if (playing) return;
    if (attemptsUsed >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
        showStatus('paddle-status', "您的 3 次挑戰機會都已使用完畢！最佳成績：" + bestScore + " 下", "warn");
        return;
    }

    playing = true;
    currentCount = 0;
    document.getElementById('count-display').innerText = currentCount;
    document.getElementById('paddle-btn').disabled = true;
    setDragZoneEnabled(true);
    showStatus('paddle-status', "🚣 賽事開始！立即按住龍舟圖片上下拖曳，剩餘 " + ROUND_SECONDS + " 秒", "info");

    roundEndTime = Date.now() + ROUND_SECONDS * 1000;
    countdownTimer = setInterval(() => {
        const remainMs = roundEndTime - Date.now();
        const remainSec = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(remainMs / 1000));
        if (remainMs <= 0) {
            endRound(id);
        } else {
            showStatus('paddle-status', "🚣 划船中！剩餘 " + remainSec + " 秒", "info");
        }
    }, 200);
}

function endRound(id) {
    clearInterval(countdownTimer);
    playing = false;
    setDragZoneEnabled(false);
    attemptsUsed++;
    if (currentCount > bestScore) bestScore = currentCount;
    saveProgress(id);
    refreshPaddleUI();
    showStatus('paddle-status', "⏱ 時間到！本回合成績：" + currentCount + " 下（最佳成績：" + bestScore + " 下）", "success");
}

function registerPaddleHit() {
    if (!playing) return;
    currentCount++;
    document.getElementById('count-display').innerText = currentCount;
}

(function initDrag() {
    const zone = document.getElementById('paddle-drag-zone');
    const icon = document.getElementById('paddle-icon');
    let dragging = false;
    let lastX = 0;
    let accumulated = 0;

    zone.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        if (!playing) return;
        dragging = true;
        lastX = e.clientX;
        zone.classList.add('dragging');
        try { zone.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) {}
    });

    zone.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        if (!dragging || !playing) return;
        const deltaX = e.clientX - lastX;
        lastX = e.clientX;
        accumulated += deltaX;

        const offset = Math.max(-70, Math.min(70, accumulated));
        const angle = Math.max(-15, Math.min(15, deltaX * 2));
        icon.style.transform = `translate(calc(-50% + ${offset}px), -50%) rotate(${angle}deg)`;

        if (Math.abs(accumulated) >= DRAG_THRESHOLD) {
            registerPaddleHit();
            accumulated = 0;
        }
    });

    function endDrag() {
        dragging = false;
        accumulated = 0;
        zone.classList.remove('dragging');
        icon.style.transform = "translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg)";
    }
    zone.addEventListener('pointerup', endDrag);
    zone.addEventListener('pointercancel', endDrag);
    zone.addEventListener('pointerleave', endDrag);
})();

/* =========================================================
   3. 神預測送出
   ========================================================= */
const FORM_URL = "https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeiTOW8H6t7m6p0ojzNTG_4_Zth69GBz8qXFT7QS7gFnDGBPg/formResponse";

function submitPrediction() {
    const id = document.getElementById('empId').value.trim();
    const team = document.getElementById('teamSelection').value;

    if (!id) { showStatus('predict-status', "請輸入工號！", "warn"); return; }
    if (!team) { showStatus('predict-status', "請選出心中的冠軍隊伍喔！", "warn"); return; }

    // 改用 URLSearchParams（application/x-www-form-urlencoded），
    // 與瀏覽器手動送出表單時使用的預設格式一致
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.append("entry.175935483", id);
    params.append("entry.1825466381", bestScore);
    params.append("entry.575129019", team);

    fetch(FORM_URL, { method: "POST", mode: "no-cors", body: params })
        .then(() => showStatus('predict-status', "✅ 預測已送出！", "success"))
        .catch(() => showStatus('predict-status', "❌ 送出時發生問題，請確認網路連線後再試一次。", "warn"));
}

/* =========================================================
   4. 背景音樂
   iOS Safari 有嚴格規定：只有使用者「直接點擊 YouTube 播放器本身的
   原生播放鍵」才會被視為合法的播放操作，任何透過程式間接呼叫的
   播放/取消靜音指令，都可能被系統判定為非同步操作而繼續消音。
   因此改為顯示一個小型、看得到控制項的播放器面板，
   由使用者自己點擊播放器內建的播放鍵。
   ========================================================= */
let musicPanelOpen = false;

function toggleMusicPanel() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('music-panel');
    const btn = document.getElementById('music-toggle');
    musicPanelOpen = !musicPanelOpen;
    if (musicPanelOpen) {
        panel.classList.add('open');
        btn.innerText = "🔊";
    } else {
        panel.classList.remove('open');
        btn.innerText = "🔇";
    }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
